short: Bound the cotangent length by orbit values

lean.name: UpperTheory.V.Alg.LemmaM
lean.plain: Bound the cotangent length by orbit values
lean.note: The length to bound is the weight $-1$ part of the cotangent space at the augmentation of a graded algebra. Under the five hypotheses, evaluating one element at a finite set of points that covers the specified ideal gives an upper bound of twice the sum of the resulting valuations.
